recipes.name: Salmon and tuna pasta
recipes.description: A filling fish pasta with onion and peas. No capers or mushrooms.
method: Boil the pasta until tender. Add the peas for the final 3 minutes, then drain.
Soften the onion in the oil in a pan. Stir in the passata, salmon and tuna and heat through.
Fold in the pasta and peas. Season with black pepper and serve.
recipes.estimateNote: Price and nutrition are rough per-meal estimates; check your own tin and packet labels.

recipes.name: Chickpea and spinach fritters
recipes.description: Crisp-edged, filling fritters made without eggs or protein powder.
method: Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork, leaving some texture.
Mix in the flour, onion, spinach and curry powder. Add a little water until the mixture just holds together.
Shape into 3 or 4 small patties. Pan-fry in a little oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until hot and browned.
recipes.estimateNote: Price and nutrition are rough estimates; the amount of oil used changes the totals.

recipes.name: Mung bean and cottage cheese bake
recipes.description: A simple, hearty bake using a full portion of cottage cheese, with no egg.

ingredients.amount: 100 g dry, or about 250 g cooked
ingredients.name: mung beans

method: If using dry mung beans, rinse and cook until soft, then drain well. Use cooked beans for a quicker bake.
Mix the beans with the cottage cheese, passata, onion, spinach and seasoning in an oven-safe dish.
Bake at 190°C for 25 to 30 minutes, until hot through and lightly browned on top.
recipes.estimateNote: Price and nutrition are rough estimates and depend on the cottage cheese brand.

recipes.name: Corned beef hash with peas
recipes.description: A cheap, filling pan hash using potatoes, onion and frozen peas.
method: Boil or microwave the diced potatoes until just tender, then drain.
Soften the onion in the oil in a frying pan. Add the potatoes and let the edges brown.
Stir in the corned beef and peas. Cook until everything is piping hot, then season with black pepper.
recipes.estimateNote: Price and nutrition are rough estimates; corned beef brands vary in fat and salt.

recipes.name: Apple and oat bakes
recipes.description: Three small apple oat cakes made with one whole egg.
method: Heat the oven to 180°C. Mix the oats, flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Stir in the grated apple, whole egg and milk until combined.
Divide between 3 small greased muffin cups. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until set.
recipes.estimateNote: Nutrition is for all 3 small bakes together; prices and values are rough estimates.
